name: myself.md
oneLiner: Connect Claude to the health, screen time and recorded location data you choose to share.
description:
Use myself.md to discover your connected phones and the export profiles you have approved, query selected phone records, and read cloud exports you explicitly share. Explore health and screen-time patterns or summarize location points you chose to record. Data types differ between iOS and Android.

Private access requires signing in to myself.md, pairing your phone, and approving the relevant profile and data grants. Phone queries may require the app to remain open and OS permissions enabled. Queries create jobs and use the same export allowance as the app; accepted requests are not completed results. The connector can propose profiles for your review, inspect retained activity metadata, read debug errors/metadata with separate consent in phone Settings, request owner-reviewed automatic-export schedule changes, and perform explicitly requested account or Isobot support actions. Support owner approvals use web dashboard Support; mobile has only Profiles and Settings.

Health records are provided for personal analysis, not medical advice. Cloud content is encrypted at rest and retained until owner deletion or replacement. Revocation stops future reads but cannot recall data already delivered to Claude. Debug logs may contain sensitive raw errors; record, credential and URL attachments are not captured. Review the privacy policy before connecting.
useCases: Discover owned phones, supported datasets and approved profiles.
Query a selected screen-time or health type and poll for a completed page.
Read an explicitly shared stored export while the phone is offline.
Propose a profile for owner review without enabling data grants.
Read consented debug error metadata, request owner-reviewed schedule changes, or open dashboard Support approvals.
prerequisites: A myself.md account signed in through a configured social provider.
The myself.md phone app installed; public mobile store distribution is not yet available.
Phone paired to the same account and approved profiles/data grants for private reads.
OS source permissions; foreground phone connectivity for live requests.
Remaining export/query allowance or an existing verified lifetime entitlement.

dataHandling.apiOwnership: myself.md account, phone and cloud APIs are first-party. Optional owner-approved support uses the operator’s Isobot service through web dashboard Support.
dataHandling.readsAndWrites: Both. Mutating or allowance-consuming tools require confirmation hints. User approval and server-side ownership checks remain enforced.
